basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI-Native Product Engineer & Founder | 0 to 1 Full-Stack Shipping on GCP | Remote-First from Zurich, Open to London Hybrid
basics.summary: Product-minded engineer who ships end-to-end (schema to UI to production) and treats AI as the leverage layer, not the feature. 13+ years of full-stack building including founding-engineer roles (Dronistics EPFL spin-off, SwissNRI regulated fintech) and 6 years at Beekeeper serving 10M+ users. Currently Lead AI Engineer at LumApps on GCP: event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, LangGraph workflow orchestration, React/TypeScript UIs streamed over AG-UI, and an AI leverage discipline (evals, tracing, cost telemetry) that lets a small team move like a big one. Remote-first from Zurich, comfortable travelling to London on a hybrid cadence. I want to help close the advice gap at Clove because financial advice, done well, is exactly the kind of high-trust product I love building.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Ship end-to-end on a Python/TypeScript stack over GCP: API design, workflow orchestration (LangGraph, Google ADK), event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, and React UIs streamed from agent state via AG-UI. Own features from schema to polished UI, no PM handoff.

Set how we build with AI: evals, tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request telemetry and MCP tool servers. The guardrails that let a small team ship like a big one, exactly the pattern-setting the JD calls out.
2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast $4M/quarter in approved opportunities. Report directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Owned features from schema to polished UI across a full-stack Vue/TypeScript/Java monolith on Kubernetes (event streams over Kafka). 10M+ frontline users, 99.99% SLA on the Employee Referral System ($1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Prototype, measure, ship, iterate: the exact loop the JD describes.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and GenAI demo generator: consumer-facing flows that used AI to make each user feel personally guided. Product-taste-driven, instrumented from day one.
Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales; every feature shipped with analytics baked in so we knew within a week whether it moved the needle. Mentored the AI cohort; set patterns others build on.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Took the product from a blank page to a live commercial platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL on AWS) that ran 500+ real-world deliveries. Set the patterns, wrote the first tests, drew the first architecture.
Enterprise-grade reliability that customers and partners could trust (Unilever partnership, CES showcase). High-trust product taste applied end-to-end, from flight-control APIs to the operator UI.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.name: I Built an AI Outbound Agent. Here's What Actually Worked.
publications.summary: Case study on shipping a production AI agent that delivered a measurable commercial lift. Where AI helps in a product loop, and where it does not.

publications.name: Your AI Needs a Brain, Not a Better Model
publications.summary: How to build the memory backbone under a product's AI layer. Practical view on RAG, temporal knowledge graphs and where each fits.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: Verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and draft-before-send patterns for autonomous agents that touch real users. Same discipline needed in a high-trust financial product.

publications.name: Microfrontends: Revolutionising Frontend Architecture
publications.summary: Product-engineering talk on shipping polished multi-audience frontends with a small team through modular architecture.

awards.title: Appreciation from John T. Chambers (ex-CEO, Cisco Systems)

projects.name: SwissNRI - 0 to 1 AI-native Financial Advice Platform
projects.description: Direct parallel to Clove's mission. Closing the advice gap for Swiss-Indian families locked out of affordable cross-border tax and financial guidance. Full product from blank page: React/TS onboarding, GCP backend, RAG-grounded adviser assistant answering DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax with citations back to the regulation, and compliance-first agentic design that flags risk before users act. High-trust and regulated by design. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in user satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.

projects.name: Anand Creations - AI-Native Building Practice
projects.description: Where I set the personal patterns for how to build with AI: prototype in a day, ship in a week, measure in production. Independent forward-deployed practice and the home for the AI products I run myself. Full-stack ownership, opinionated tooling (Claude Code, MCP servers, evals-as-tests, cost telemetry) and a hard rule that the human experience beats the technical demo.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail investors. Agents ingest technical and news data, form a hypothesis and generate AND justify a signal with cited evidence: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Explainability, evaluation and back-testing baked into a polished consumer UI. Built for my own portfolio first, then opened up. Small-team, 0 to 1, product-taste-driven.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Clove is an early-stage London fintech closing the advice gap by combining trusted advisers with technology. One of the first hires. Product engineer across consumer, adviser and internal surfaces on a modular Go monolith with React frontends on GCP. AI-native, event-driven, workflow orchestration, first-principles.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong technical/culture fit. Location: Hybrid London, candidate is Zurich-based; positioned as remote-first with regular London trips (worth addressing head-on in a short cover letter). Go: no direct Go experience but strong Java/Python/TS fundamentals; JD explicitly says similar tech works. Angle: 0 to 1 fintech (SwissNRI) as direct mission parallel, AI-native building practice, product-eng end-to-end craft on GCP.
